resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register and Fire Lookout give 3,600 ft (1,097 m); WillhiteWeb gives a lookout elevation of 3,680 feet. The record's 1097.3 m matches the Register. The story reports both figures.
The Register and Forest Lookouts say the cab was removed in 1951. WillhiteWeb says destroyed around 1951, and Fire Lookout says destroyed in the 1950s. The story reports both.

sources.title: Edgar Rock Lookout Site - Naches Ranger District

notes_for_editor: Sources are thin: no staffing or notable fires named in any source read. The WillhiteWeb trip report is undated and its photos are captioned 1942 and 1996, so the remnants claim may be old. One web search returned a social-media post describing the lookout as gone with a few remnants; it was not fetched or cited. The brief's status gone and kind ground match the sources. Access is recorded as public because the trail is open to hikers per WillhiteWeb; no closure or land-manager notice was read. Photos on firetower.org were not read (images), and no new photo URLs are listed.
